Appearance:
 Shri Manish Datt - Senior Advocate with Shri Siddharth Bend
 for applicant.
Smt. Geeta Yadav - Govt. Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No.448/2024 dated 21.11.2024 registered at Police Station - Dehat, District Tikamgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 409, 417, 467, 468, 471 and 475 of the IPC and also under sections 13(1)(c) and 13(2)
of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the present applicant was working as a Manager with M/s S.P.R. Borewells, Tamil Nadu.
The proprietor of the said firm Late P. Rangrajan expired on 12-12-2000 and thereafter, the firm carried out the work of digging borewells for a period of 2 years.

Towards the said work payments were made to the tune of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:1283 2 MCRC-183-2025 Rs.6,17,305/-.

As the present applicant was working as a Manager, therefore, the liability is being sought to be fixed upon the present applicant after lapse of 24 years, as admittedly, the entire transaction pertains to the year 2000-2001.
Thus, the counsel submits that the present applicant deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

3. The counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and submitted that the present applicant was well aware that the proprietor of the firm was no more, yet the payments towards the work were Rajesh Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151606412/
1 received, which in fact ought to have been made to the legal representative of the late proprietor.

5. Having considered the submissions, it is evident that the transaction pertains to the year 2000 and the FIR has been lodged after lapse of 24 years vide Crime No.448/2024.

Therefore,
considering the totality of the circumstances this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting Officer/trial Court concerned for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court during course of trial, as the case may be, during NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1283 3 MCRC-183-2025 the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
